messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to use the get_stock_prices function to retrieve Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla stock prices for durations: 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. They want separate data for each company? The function signature expects companies: string[], duration: string. So we can call it multiple times with different durations. But maybe we can combine all companies into one list and specify duration? But they want each company separately for each duration. We could call four times: once for each duration with all companies. That would give us data for all companies for each duration. That seems efficient.

Thus we will call get_stock_prices with companies ["Apple", "Microsoft", "Amazon", "Tesla"] and duration "1 week". Then again with "2 weeks", then "3 weeks", then "1 month".

We need to output the calls. According to guidelines, we should not provide additional text beyond the function calls. So we will produce four function calls.
